hypothesis: A derivative term in a stable discrete feedback controller could explain why the previous proportional/integral families matched few breaths. Test a nested PI/PID comparison on identical eligible rows; do not loosen prior near-exact thresholds.
provenance: Independent equations inspired by supplied S01/S02 feedback-matching synthesis only; no linked solution code, original Kaggle data or pretrained solution downloaded.
pressure_parse: Raw float64 only for the 576 original-A-fit breaths; skip other breath rows before parsing pressure. Original A validation/test excluded. E was a resampling inside Afit; 72 sampled training breaths overlap its validation IDs, as already disclosed. This is not a fresh holdout evaluation.
shared_eligible_rows: All families require current/previous unclipped controls and all pressure lags within the same inspiratory breath; same chronological cut.
RANSAC_selection: Fitting-control inlier count abs(residual)<1e-4, then fitting median absolute residual. Physical admissibility gates the selected candidate afterward. No held-control candidate selection or refit.
diagnostic_units: Valve-control units using known training pressures, NOT pressure MAE or input-only recovery coverage.
gate: A PID family/lag/estimator must meet both >=10% near-exact sample fraction and >=2 percentage-point improvement over the matched PI case. No threshold/family retuning on outcomes.
next_if_pass: Develop and independently test an input-only pressure reconstruction with fit-only parameters/grid, then prospective grouped validation. Passing this conditional training diagnostic alone cannot promote a model or authorize a submission.
